title: Backup & Restore Health
objective: Memantau backup completion, encryption, restore, media manifest, cross-workspace links, dan recovery time.
decision_rule: Tanpa observasi = BLOCKED tanpa klaim kesehatan; cakupan enam sinyal belum lengkap atau observasi tanpa catatan = FAIL; backup_success ok sementara encryption_success failed = FAIL encryption_failure_ignored; backup_success failed sementara restore_success failed = FAIL backup_restore_unrecovered; media_integrity failed sementara restore_success failed = FAIL media_unrecovered; link_integrity failed sementara restore_success failed = FAIL links_unrepaired; recovery_time ok sementara restore_success failed = FAIL recovery_claim_without_restore; restore_success failed sementara recovery_time tidak ok = FAIL restore_unrecovered; kegagalan terdeteksi yang pulih jujur (restore_success recovered/ok tanpa pelanggaran) = PASS konsistensi; cakupan lengkap tanpa invalidasi atau pelanggaran = PASS.
limitations: Sinyal dinilai dari observasi lokal/definisi kontrak; backup telemetry workspace produksi live belum diamati.
Fault test destruktif atas data pengguna, restore end-to-end pada data nyata, verifikasi perangkat keras, dan publikasi distribusi tetap DEFERRED-EXTERNAL.
